scenes.voice: The first result on Google can be the wrong place to pay your bill.
scenes.caption: THE FIRST RESULT CAN BE WRONG.
scenes.title: YOU SEARCHED FOR THE RIGHT COMPANY.
scenes.body: The top result can still send you somewhere else.

scenes.voice: A paid ad can use the company's name and look like the official payment page.
scenes.caption: PAID AD ≠ OFFICIAL SITE

scenes.voice: The F.T.C. warned about this on August seventeenth. Dishonest companies can use paid search ads to impersonate the payment channel you were looking for.
scenes.caption: THE FTC JUST WARNED ABOUT THIS.
scenes.focus: dishonest companies sometimes use paid search ads to trick you into paying them instead of the company or agency you're looking for

scenes.voice: The trap works because being first in search feels like being official. It isn't.
scenes.caption: FIRST DOESN'T MEAN OFFICIAL.
scenes.label: SEARCH RESULT ≠ VERIFIED

scenes.voice: The safer move is simple. Scroll past paid results, or type the company's real website address yourself.
scenes.caption: CONTROL THE DESTINATION.
scenes.focus: Scroll past the paid search results to help make sure you have the right website or contact info.

scenes.voice: If an ad chooses where you pay, verify before you pay.
scenes.caption: VERIFY BEFORE YOU PAY.
scenes.title: LOOKS LEGIT.
